items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I met Bill Vodery here in New York, when I went in the Army in 1918, he was bandmaster.

ctx.x: I had a girl in every town.

That was the era. Now, you wanted to talk about -- I wanted to get back to some of the things in the '30s and the '20s that was very important to you. And we haven't spoken too much about it. We spoke of it gradually last time. But go ahead and talk about Will Vodery, which I know you admired.
Oh, yeah. I met Bill Vodery here in New York, when I went in the Army in 1918, he was bandmaster.
